name: Continue
writeNote: derm has no YAML writer, and Continue's mcpServers is a list; paste the fragment under mcpServers: in ~/.continue/config.yaml (CONTINUE_GLOBAL_DIR moves it), which also needs top-level name: and version:. With no config.yaml, cn loads a remote default config and reads no local server.
nameMangling: not read in this chat: the bare tool name is the planned row's, from note AQ (NF)
sources: npm @continuedev/cli@1.5.47, bin cn; its gitHead d3f60ba in github.com/continuedev/continue (sparse clone): packages/config-yaml/src/schemas/mcp/index.ts:4-35, packages/config-yaml/src/schemas/index.ts:100-139, packages/config-yaml/src/load/unroll.ts:83, extensions/cli/src/env.ts:10-11, extensions/cli/src/configLoader.ts:88-100, 305-313, extensions/cli/src/CLIPlatformClient.ts:22-81 (lane Q, third chat, 3 Nov 2026)
notes: cn reads --config, else <CONTINUE_GLOBAL_DIR or ~/.continue>/config.yaml, else a remote default config (V, configLoader.ts:88-100, env.ts:10-11). The file needs name and version (V, schemas/index.ts:100-107); mcpServers is a list of stdio {name, command, type?: stdio, args?, env?, cwd?} or remote {name, url, type?: sse | streamable-http, apiKey?, requestOptions?} entries, or a hub block with uses (V, schemas/mcp/index.ts:4-35, schemas/index.ts:128-139). ${{ secrets.X }} anywhere in the file is a template (V, unroll.ts:83); cn fills it from the environment variable X, then from ~/.continue/.env, then from the workspace's .continue/.env and .env (V, CLIPlatformClient.ts:42-81), so a repository's .env can supply a value for a variable that is not exported. No add command and no comment-keeping writer, so derm prints.
